title: The water (prevention and control of pollution) cess act, 1977
full_text: The water (prevention and control of pollution) cess act, 1977 जल (प्रदूषण निवारण तथा नियंत्रण) अधिनियम, 1974 (1974 का 6) के प्रयोजनों के लिए और उसके अधीन उपयोग के लिए उपकर का उद्वहण और संग्रहण किया जाएगा। Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197736 Act Number: 36 Enactment Date: 1977-12-07 Act Year: 1977 Short Title: The water (prevention and control of pollution) cess act, 1977 Hindi Title: जल (प्रदूषण निवारण तथा नियंत्रण) अधिनियम, 1974 (1974 का 6) के प्रयोजनों के लिए और उसके अधीन उपयोग के लिए उपकर का उद्वहण और संग्रहण किया जाएगा। Long Title: An Act to provide for the levy and collection of a cess on water consumed by persons carrying on certain industries and by local authorities, with a view to augment the resources of the Central Board and the State Boards for the prevention and control of water pollution constituted under the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974. Department: Environment Department Enforcement Date: 01-04-1978 Type: STATE Location: Rajasthan Notification: 1st April, 1978, vide notification No. G.S.R. 189(E), dated 23rd March, 1978, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3 (i).
